title: EBC 707: In-Place Material, Component Properties and Archaic Structural Systems
officialText:
707.1 General.

Methods of design and properties of in-place structural materials, components, and assemblies, including archaic structural systems, shall be determined according to Appendix H or other requirements specified in this code.
